name: BACH_0064
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (71%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Benign · Careful review
The 90% conformal set includes Benign, and 4/5 nearest reference cases are Normal.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 71%, Benign 16%, Normal 14%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Favors InSitu; zero invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (10% alpha; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Cannot exclude benign lesion |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 100th OOD percentile, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Atypical OOD, reliable; 70% error AUROC |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent models agree with each other |
| Similar cases | 1/5 InSitu, 4/5 Normal (77%–81% similarity) [F5] | Mostly Normal nearest neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 0, 2, 6) · context · Above-typical score; largest shift away from invasion (-1.391) [F2] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.231) slightly raises invasive score [F3] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Typical score (-0.223) lowers invasive probability [F4] · Validated
- **Immune cell fraction** (regions 4, 8, 9) · context · 18% immune cells (100th percentile); scarce tumor nuclei [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing 3 top-risk regions drops invasive score above random (95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unverified by deletion (95% CI -0.0088–0.0064); mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), and necrosis (3/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Dense inflammation in regions 0, 2, 6 mimics in situ change on a normal or benign background.
- Sparse epithelium (3%, 4th percentile [F9]) and insufficient tumor nuclei (regions 4, 8, 9) under-sample atypia.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 4, 9**: Check ducts and 18 tumor nuclei for DCIS vs hyperplasia (drafted: ER, CK5/6, deeper levels).
2. **Region 8**: Inspect the sole nonzero risk score (0.002) and stromal signal to confirm absent invasion.
3. **Regions 0, 2, 6, 9**: Verify dense lymphoid infiltrate and high dead-cell fraction (2%, 93rd percentile [F8]).
